Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “burns” to mean core fusion temperature instead of surface temperature, despite the source confirming red giants have cooler surfaces. They then incorrectly concluded that “greater density and gravity” (C) distinguishes red giants, conflating a dense core with the star’s overall density and typical surface gravity (which are generally lower in red giants). This led to overturning the correct choice (A) and selecting the wrong option (C).
